answer: A newcomer enters the garden with a sponsor. The sponsor signs with a quill, locking 55 credits. Each fake caught costs a plume and 10% standing; at its nadir the sponsor loses admission and credits burn. The k-th fake under a sponsor costs 55+9(k-1); 1,000 fakes lock 4,550,500 for a 40,000 pool. Backing a farm fails: one farm voids the garden, burning every bond. An honest sponsor vouches once, pays 55 once, keeps standing and bond.
